examples.hanzi: 你明早有时间吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ míngzǎo yǒu shíjiān ma?
examples.english: Do you have time tomorrow morning?

examples.hanzi: 我们明早在门口见面吧。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen míngzǎo zài ménkǒu jiànmiàn ba.
examples.english: Let's meet at the entrance tomorrow morning.

examples.hanzi: 今天是我第六次来这里。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān shì wǒ dì liù cì lái zhèlǐ.
examples.english: This is the sixth time I've come here.

examples.hanzi: 请翻到第六页。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng fān dào dìliù yè.
examples.english: Please turn to page six.

examples.hanzi: 我的自行车坏了，得去修一修。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de zìxíngchē huài le, děi qù xiū yi xiū.
examples.english: My bike is broken; I need to get it repaired.

examples.hanzi: 周末我们骑自行车去郊外。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò wǒmen qí zìxíngchē qù jiāowài.
examples.english: This weekend we're cycling to the countryside.

examples.hanzi: 我的邻居是一位犹太老人。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de línjū shì yí wèi Yóutài lǎorén.
examples.english: My neighbor is an elderly Jewish man.

examples.hanzi: 她在博物馆里了解了犹太文化。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài bówùguǎn lǐ liǎojiě le Yóutài wénhuà.
examples.english: She learned about Jewish culture at the museum.

examples.hanzi: 红灯是停车的标志。
examples.pinyin: Hóngdēng shì tíngchē de biāozhì.
examples.english: A red light is the sign to stop.

examples.hanzi: 这个标志是什么意思？
examples.pinyin: Zhège biāozhì shì shénme yìsi?
examples.english: What does this sign mean?

examples.hanzi: 我在浴室里看到了一只蜘蛛。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài yùshì lǐ kàn dào le yì zhī zhīzhū.
examples.english: I saw a spider in the bathroom.

examples.hanzi: 蜘蛛在窗边织了一张网。
examples.pinyin: Zhīzhū zài chuāng biān zhī le yì zhāng wǎng.
examples.english: A spider has spun a web by the window.

examples.hanzi: 你这是狗屁不通的借口。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhè shì gǒupì bù tōng de jièkǒu.
examples.english: That's a nonsensical excuse.

examples.hanzi: 他说的都是狗屁，别信他。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuō de dōu shì gǒupì, bié xìn tā.
examples.english: What he says is all nonsense, so don't believe him.

examples.hanzi: 我想吃一个汉堡。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng chī yí ge hànbǎo.
examples.english: I'd like to eat a hamburger.

examples.hanzi: 这家店的汉堡又大又好吃。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn de hànbǎo yòu dà yòu hǎochī.
examples.english: The hamburgers at this shop are big and tasty.

examples.hanzi: 离考试还早，你不用着急。
examples.pinyin: Lí kǎoshì hái zǎo, nǐ búyòng zháojí.
examples.english: The exam is still a way off, so there's no need to worry.

examples.hanzi: 他等了很久，开始着急了。
examples.pinyin: Tā děng le hěn jiǔ, kāishǐ zháojí le.
examples.english: He had waited a long time and began to get anxious.

examples.hanzi: 做决定时不要冲动。
examples.pinyin: Zuò juédìng shí búyào chōngdòng.
examples.english: Don't be impulsive when making decisions.

examples.hanzi: 我真想冲动一次，辞职去旅行。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhēn xiǎng chōngdòng yí cì, cízhí qù lǚxíng.
examples.english: I really want to act on impulse once and quit my job to travel.

examples.hanzi: 这个包的带子断了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège bāo de dàizi duàn le.
examples.english: The strap of this bag broke.

examples.hanzi: 他系好鞋带子就出门了。
examples.pinyin: Tā jì hǎo xié dàizi jiù chūmén le.
examples.english: He tied his shoelaces and went out.

examples.hanzi: 他会演奏三种乐器。
examples.pinyin: Tā huì yǎnzòu sān zhǒng yuèqì.
examples.english: He can play three instruments.

examples.hanzi: 乐队正在演奏一首老歌。
examples.pinyin: Yuèduì zhèngzài yǎnzòu yì shǒu lǎo gē.
examples.english: The band is playing an old song.

examples.hanzi: 我亲眼看见他把钱包放进了包里。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qīnyǎn kànjiàn tā bǎ qiánbāo fàng jìn le bāo lǐ.
examples.english: I saw with my own eyes that he put the wallet in the bag.

examples.hanzi: 你应该亲眼去看看。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yīnggāi qīnyǎn qù kànkan.
examples.english: You should go and see for yourself.

examples.hanzi: 这位富有的商人捐了很多钱。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi fùyǒu de shāngrén juān le hěn duō qián.
examples.english: This wealthy businessman donated a lot of money.

examples.hanzi: 这里的文化富有特色。
examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de wénhuà fùyǒu tèsè.
examples.english: The culture here is rich in character.

examples.hanzi: 我昨晚好像出现了幻觉。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuówǎn hǎoxiàng chūxiàn le huànjué.
examples.english: Last night I seemed to have an illusion.

examples.hanzi: 这只是你的幻觉，那里什么也没有。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǐshì nǐ de huànjué, nàlǐ shénme yě méiyǒu.
examples.english: It's just your imagination; there's nothing there.

examples.hanzi: 这本书的封面设计很漂亮。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū de fēngmiàn shèjì hěn piàoliang.
examples.english: This book's cover design is beautiful.

examples.hanzi: 她的照片登上了杂志封面。
examples.pinyin: Tā de zhàopiàn dēng shàng le zázhì fēngmiàn.
examples.english: Her photo appeared on the magazine cover.

examples.hanzi: 我想努力工作，多赚钱。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng nǔlì gōngzuò, duō zhuànqián.
examples.english: I want to work hard and earn more money.

examples.hanzi: 做这个生意赚钱吗？
examples.pinyin: Zuò zhège shēngyi zhuànqián ma?
examples.english: Does this business make money?

examples.hanzi: 周六我不上班。
examples.pinyin: Zhōuliù wǒ bú shàngbān.
examples.english: I don't work on Saturday.

examples.hanzi: 下周六是我的生日。
examples.pinyin: Xià zhōuliù shì wǒ de shēngrì.
examples.english: Next Saturday is my birthday.

examples.hanzi: 孩子偷偷吃了一块糖。
examples.pinyin: Háizi tōutōu chī le yí kuài táng.
examples.english: The child secretly ate a piece of candy.

examples.hanzi: 她偷偷地笑了。
examples.pinyin: Tā tōutōu de xiào le.
examples.english: She smiled secretly.

examples.hanzi: 我们要对抗疾病。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào duìkàng jíbìng.
examples.english: We must fight disease.

examples.hanzi: 他们不想和老板对抗。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen bù xiǎng hé lǎobǎn duìkàng.
examples.english: They don't want to confront the boss.

examples.hanzi: 我们参观了一座古老的城堡。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen cānguān le yí zuò gǔlǎo de chéngbǎo.
examples.english: We visited an ancient castle.

examples.hanzi: 孩子们用沙子堆了一座城堡。
examples.pinyin: Háizimen yòng shāzi duī le yí zuò chéngbǎo.
examples.english: The children built a castle out of sand.

examples.hanzi: 飞机已经安全降落了。
examples.pinyin: Fēijī yǐjīng ānquán jiàngluò le.
examples.english: The plane has already landed safely.

examples.hanzi: 气温明天会降落到零度以下。
examples.pinyin: Qìwēn míngtiān huì jiàngluò dào língdù yǐxià.
examples.english: The temperature will drop below zero tomorrow.

examples.hanzi: 报纸上说杀人犯已经被抓住了。
examples.pinyin: Bàozhǐ shàng shuō shārénfàn yǐjīng bèi zhuā zhù le.
examples.english: The newspaper says the murderer has been caught.

examples.hanzi: 那个杀人犯被判了二十年。
examples.pinyin: Nàge shārénfàn bèi pàn le èrshí nián.
examples.english: That murderer was sentenced to twenty years.

examples.hanzi: 今天和平常一样，很安静。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān hé píngcháng yíyàng, hěn ānjìng.
examples.english: Today is the same as usual, very quiet.

examples.hanzi: 这只是一件很平常的小事。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǐshì yí jiàn hěn píngcháng de xiǎoshì.
examples.english: This is just an ordinary little matter.

examples.hanzi: 我的肩膀很疼，想去按摩。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de jiānbǎng hěn téng, xiǎng qù ànmó.
examples.english: My shoulders ache and I want to get a massage.

examples.hanzi: 爸爸喜欢让我给他按摩。
examples.pinyin: Bàba xǐhuan ràng wǒ gěi tā ànmó.
examples.english: Dad likes me to give him a massage.

examples.hanzi: 他本身就是一名医生。
examples.pinyin: Tā běnshēn jiù shì yì míng yīshēng.
examples.english: He himself is a doctor.

examples.hanzi: 工作本身不难，难的是时间太紧。
examples.pinyin: Gōngzuò běnshēn bù nán, nán de shì shíjiān tài jǐn.
examples.english: The work itself isn't hard; the hard part is the tight schedule.

examples.hanzi: 疑犯昨晚已经被带走了。
examples.pinyin: Yífàn zuówǎn yǐjīng bèi dài zǒu le.
examples.english: The suspect was taken away last night.

examples.hanzi: 警察在找另一名疑犯。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngchá zài zhǎo lìng yì míng yífàn.
examples.english: The police are looking for another suspect.

examples.hanzi: 那个国家早就废除了奴隶制度。
examples.pinyin: Nàge guójiā zǎo jiù fèichú le núlì zhìdù.
examples.english: That country abolished the slave system long ago.

examples.hanzi: 这部电影讲了一个奴隶的故事。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng jiǎng le yí ge núlì de gùshi.
examples.english: This movie tells the story of a slave.

examples.hanzi: 你走慢点，等我赶上你。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zǒu màn diǎn, děng wǒ gǎnshàng nǐ.
examples.english: Slow down and wait for me to catch up with you.

examples.hanzi: 快点，我们要赶上最后一班车。
examples.pinyin: Kuài diǎn, wǒmen yào gǎn shàng zuìhòu yì bān chē.
examples.english: Hurry up, we need to catch the last bus.

examples.hanzi: 半夜里突然有声音，真吓人。
examples.pinyin: Bànyè lǐ tūrán yǒu shēngyīn, zhēn xiàrén.
examples.english: A sudden noise in the middle of the night is really scary.

examples.hanzi: 别吓人了，我胆子很小。
examples.pinyin: Bié xiàrén le, wǒ dǎnzi hěn xiǎo.
examples.english: Stop scaring people; I'm quite timid.

examples.hanzi: 新闻里说市中心发生了枪击案。
examples.pinyin: Xīnwén lǐ shuō shì zhōngxīn fāshēng le qiāngjī àn.
examples.english: The news says a shooting happened downtown.

examples.hanzi: 他在枪击中受了伤。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài qiāngjī zhōng shòu le shāng.
examples.english: He was wounded in the shooting.

examples.hanzi: 迈克尔是我大学的同学。
examples.pinyin: Màikè'ěr shì wǒ dàxué de tóngxué.
examples.english: Michael is my college classmate.

examples.hanzi: 迈克尔明天要来我家吃饭。
examples.pinyin: Màikè'ěr míngtiān yào lái wǒ jiā chīfàn.
examples.english: Michael is coming to my house for dinner tomorrow.

examples.hanzi: 他练了十年功夫，身体很好。
examples.pinyin: Tā liàn le shí nián gōngfu, shēntǐ hěn hǎo.
examples.english: He practiced kung fu for ten years and is in great shape.

examples.hanzi: 学外语需要花功夫。
examples.pinyin: Xué wàiyǔ xūyào huā gōngfu.
examples.english: Learning a foreign language takes time and effort.

examples.hanzi: 我爷爷住在乡村，空气很好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yéye zhù zài xiāngcūn, kōngqì hěn hǎo.
examples.english: My grandfather lives in the countryside, where the air is good.

examples.hanzi: 乡村的夜晚特别安静。
examples.pinyin: Xiāngcūn de yèwǎn tèbié ānjìng.
examples.english: Nights in the countryside are especially quiet.

examples.hanzi: 请给我一份完整的名单。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng gěi wǒ yí fèn wánzhěng de míngdān.
examples.english: Please give me a complete list.

examples.hanzi: 这个故事我只听了一半，不完整。
examples.pinyin: Zhège gùshi wǒ zhǐ tīng le yíbàn, bù wánzhěng.
examples.english: I only heard half of this story, so it's incomplete.

examples.hanzi: 苏格兰的风景非常美。
examples.pinyin: Sūgélán de fēngjǐng fēicháng měi.
examples.english: The scenery in Scotland is very beautiful.

examples.hanzi: 他说话带着苏格兰口音。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuōhuà dài zhe Sūgélán kǒuyīn.
examples.english: He speaks with a Scottish accent.

examples.hanzi: 你别在意，他没有恶意。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié zàiyì, tā méiyǒu èyì.
examples.english: Don't mind it; he meant no harm.

examples.hanzi: 我一点也不在意天气好不好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yìdiǎn yě bú zàiyì tiānqì hǎo bu hǎo.
examples.english: I don't care at all whether the weather is good.

examples.hanzi: 宝宝一直张着嘴巴笑。
examples.pinyin: Bǎobao yìzhí zhāng zhe zuǐba xiào.
examples.english: The baby kept laughing with his mouth open.

examples.hanzi: 吃东西的时候请闭上嘴巴。
examples.pinyin: Chī dōngxi de shíhou qǐng bì shàng zuǐba.
examples.english: Please close your mouth when eating.

examples.hanzi: 我家老大今年上初中了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā lǎodà jīnnián shàng chūzhōng le.
examples.english: Our eldest child is starting middle school this year.

examples.hanzi: 老大带着大家一起干活。
examples.pinyin: Lǎodà dài zhe dàjiā yìqǐ gànhuó.
examples.english: The boss leads everyone to work together.

examples.hanzi: 这条大道通向市中心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo dàdào tōng xiàng shì zhōngxīn.
examples.english: This avenue leads to the city center.

examples.hanzi: 他们沿着大道一直往前走。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen yán zhe dàdào yìzhí wǎng qián zǒu.
examples.english: They walked straight ahead along the avenue.

examples.hanzi: 周末我想去拜访老师。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò wǒ xiǎng qù bàifǎng lǎoshī.
examples.english: This weekend I'd like to visit my teacher.

examples.hanzi: 他拜访了几位重要的客户。
examples.pinyin: Tā bàifǎng le jǐ wèi zhòngyào de kèhù.
examples.english: He paid visits to several important clients.

examples.hanzi: 詹姆斯是我哥哥的名字。
examples.pinyin: Zhānmǔsī shì wǒ gēge de míngzi.
examples.english: James is my older brother's name.

examples.hanzi: 詹姆斯在办公室加班。
examples.pinyin: Zhānmǔsī zài bàngōngshì jiābān.
examples.english: James is working overtime at the office.

examples.hanzi: 朋友之间要相互帮助。
examples.pinyin: Péngyou zhījiān yào xiānghù bāngzhù.
examples.english: Friends should help each other.

examples.hanzi: 我们相互认识很多年了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xiānghù rènshi hěn duō nián le.
examples.english: We've known each other for many years.

examples.hanzi: 医生需要一份血液样本。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng xūyào yí fèn xuèyè yàngběn.
examples.english: The doctor needs a blood sample.

examples.hanzi: 请先看一下样本，再决定要不要买。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng xiān kàn yíxià yàngběn, zài juédìng yào bu yào mǎi.
examples.english: Please look at the sample first, then decide whether to buy.

examples.hanzi: 我决不会忘记你的帮助。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jué bú huì wàngjì nǐ de bāngzhù.
examples.english: I will never forget your help.

examples.hanzi: 这件事我决不同意。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì wǒ jué bù tóngyì.
examples.english: I absolutely won't agree to this.

examples.hanzi: 他在黑帮电影里演过老大。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài hēibāng diànyǐng lǐ yǎn guo lǎodà.
examples.english: He played a boss in a gangster movie.

examples.hanzi: 我喜欢看黑帮题材的电影。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan kàn hēibāng tícái de diànyǐng.
examples.english: I like watching gangster-themed movies.

examples.hanzi: 她靠在我的肩膀上睡着了。
examples.pinyin: Tā kào zài wǒ de jiānbǎng shàng shuìzháo le.
examples.english: She fell asleep leaning on my shoulder.

examples.hanzi: 他拍了拍我的肩膀，说谢谢。
examples.pinyin: Tā pāi le pāi wǒ de jiānbǎng, shuō xièxie.
examples.english: He patted my shoulder and said thanks.

examples.hanzi: 这家商店在网上做宣传。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā shāngdiàn zài wǎngshàng zuò xuānchuán.
examples.english: This store does promotion online.

examples.hanzi: 学校宣传环保的重要性。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào xuānchuán huánbǎo de zhòngyàoxìng.
examples.english: The school promotes the importance of environmental protection.

examples.hanzi: 我妈妈对我很严格。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ māma duì wǒ hěn yángé.
examples.english: My mom is very strict with me.

examples.hanzi: 这家工厂有严格的安全规定。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngchǎng yǒu yángé de ānquán guīdìng.
examples.english: This factory has strict safety rules.

examples.hanzi: 考了第一名，老师给了我一份奖励。
examples.pinyin: Kǎo le dì yī míng, lǎoshī gěi le wǒ yí fèn jiǎnglì.
examples.english: I got first place, and the teacher gave me a reward.

examples.hanzi: 这个小孩做完作业就奖励自己看动画片。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiǎohái zuò wán zuòyè jiù jiǎnglì zìjǐ kàn dònghuàpiàn.
examples.english: After finishing his homework, this kid rewards himself by watching cartoons.
